newsitem.title: USA: TWA matches Northwest fare sale.
newsitem.headline: TWA matches Northwest fare sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Wednesday it will match a fare sale initiated by Northwest Airlines Corp by offering discounts of up to 50 percent on routes that compete with Northwest.
As part of the sale, up to two children can accompany an adult for prices ranging from $98 to $198 round trip, Trans World said.

The tickets require one-week advance pruchase and are nonrefundable. Travel must take place between May 6 and September 6 and must be purchased by April 14, the airline said. A Saturday night stay is required.
